visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large cardboard box sits on a light-colored wooden floor in a home setting. A person's hands and legs are visible as they prepare to open the box, which features MSI and Toy Story branding, including a 'KEEP YOUR EYES ON THE CASE' graphic with Alien characters. (2) The box is opened to reveal a white envelope containing a 'Certificate of Authenticity' for the Toy Story 30th Anniversary Special Editions, showing serial number 7/500. (3) A series of close-up shots showcase various MSI computer components with Toy Story themes: a Woody-themed Z890 motherboard, a Buzz Lightyear-themed GeForce RTX 5070 GPU, and a Zurg-themed power supply unit. (4) A male creator with long dark hair pops up from behind the large box, looking excited and surprised. (5) The person removes white foam packaging to reveal a custom white PC case with clear glass panels, featuring 'SPACE CRANE' text and Alien graphics. (6) The person's hands carefully peel off the protective plastic film from the glass panels of the PC case, creating visual texture and reflections. (7) A close-up shows a finger pressing a red 'START' button on the front I/O panel of the PC. (8) The PC powers on, and the internal RGB fans light up in vibrant green and white. A small LCD screen on the AIO liquid cooler displays an animated Alien character waving. (9) Detailed shots explore the interior: Woody-inspired cow print heatsinks, 'To Infinity and Beyond' graphics on the GPU backplate, and various Toy Story stickers on the fans. (10) The final scene shows the creator sitting next to the fully assembled, lit-up PC and its packaging, giving a thumbs up to the camera while smiling.
